facts.fact: claude.go: Call is one isolated structured Claude Code request.
claude.go: Runner runs one Call, returns structured_output object.
claude.go: Result is finished call: structured_output plus spending Claude Code reported.
Call.MCPConfig, when set, is inline --mcp-config JSON naming only MCP servers call may use.
When Call.MCPConfig set, AllowedTools lists only tools call may call.
Call.Tools, when set, are built-in read-only file tools call may use, confined to its temp dir.
Call.MaxTurns caps tool loop (--max-turns); 0 leaves it off.
CLIRunner drives claude CLI headless with every source of ambient context switched off.
Model sees only our system prompt and stdin document; claudeArgs is the isolation contract.
CLIRunner does not use --bare: --bare forces ANTHROPIC_API_KEY auth, never reads OAuth/keychain, which breaks subscription login.
--restricted confines Read and Grep to working dir, drops code-running tools.
Without --restricted, Read opens absolute path outside cwd even under --safe-mode.
